name: pipeline_benzene_computed
purpose: TASKS 168 (the user, 3 Nov: 'Ja, doe dat vanavond maar'): benzene from its SMILES through the current pipeline with every step computed (--no-reuse), so the show's one benzene is a run of the pipeline as it stands and not a reuse of the corpus folder
command: env CORPUS_QC_PYTHON=C:/Users/thebr/.conda/envs/qc/python.exe PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m m08.pipeline --name benzene --smiles c1ccccc1 --out ../../probes/results_m1/pipeline_benzene_computed_2026-11-03 --threads 6 --psi4-memory-gb 4 --wsl-cap-mb 6144 --no-reuse

estimate.basis: the 0.4 benzene of 30 Oct: steps 2-3 in 337 s on this laptop; the network and the spectrum in seconds

memory.basis: as pipeline_benzene (29 Oct): the WSL step runs under probes/wsl_capped.sh at 6144 MB; psi4 is given 4 GB and runs before it, not beside it
